purpose: Audit a parameter-free, gauge-safe source-level controller derived from the fraction of individual baryonic Newtonian vectors that survives vector summation, before reading any galaxy or cluster score.

equation.gauge_safe_base: solve Laplacian(Phi_base)=S_base with the coherent potential as the Dirichlet boundary
equation.physical_interpretation: aligned source vectors select the coherent radial completion; locally cancelling multi-center vectors retain the local field-equation source
equation.self_cell_rule: the discrete self-pair contributes zero to both vector and unsummed strength; no softening length is introduced

numerics.rotation_test: swap x and y axes of the two-center field and compare correspondingly transposed results
numerics.translation_test: translate the compact single source by two native x cells and compare the overlapping field after the same translation
numerics.convolution: zero-padded linear FFT convolution using the exact native-grid 1/r^2 magnitude and vector kernels

selection_rule: Advance the exact local-vector-coherence source operator to one separately frozen spent joint screen only if every coherence-bound, single-center, two-center, rotation, translation, resolution, source-identity, endpoint, residual, curl, boundary, hybrid, strong-field, finite, accounting, no-observation, and sealed-target gate passes. No softening, smoothing, exponent, threshold, offset, multiplier, or fitted physical quantity may be added after this audit.
claim_boundary: P0698 is a numerical and mathematical audit, not an observational test.
The discrete pairwise coherence is nonlocal and is not yet derived from a covariant action or causal evolution equation.
Using the coherent potential as the finite-domain boundary privileges the single-center endpoint and requires later field-of-view robustness.
